committees.name: Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects all federal banking agencies, depository institutions, and insured credit unions nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: Each Federal financial institutions regulatory agency shall take into consideration the risk profile and business models

dimensions.assessment: Modifies agency examination guidelines and regulatory burdens for financial institutions, removing a supervisory metric.
dimensions.evidence: Each Federal banking agency shall remove from any guidance, rule, examination manual... any reference to reputational risk

dimensions.assessment: Requires internal agency reviews, reporting to Congress, and reduced reporting for certain community banks, but does not state specific appropriations or spending levels.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs of the Senate and the Committee on Financial Services of the House of Representatives a report

dimensions.assessment: Amends supervisory practices of federal banking agencies by barring a specific risk category and enforcing regulatory tailoring and short-form call reports.
dimensions.evidence: No Federal banking agency may engage in any activity concerning or related to the regulation, supervision, or examination, of the reputational risk

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory prohibition on using reputational risk in supervision, alongside ongoing annual reports and regulatory reviews.
dimensions.evidence: Each Federal financial institutions regulatory agency shall submit... not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, and annually thereafter

missing_information: Exact figures for cost savings or compliance burdens on financial institutions are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill prohibits federal banking agencies from considering reputational risk during examinations and supervision, requires regulatory tailoring for depository institutions, and mandates reports to Congress.
